CheckConfig.description: What `dx check --affected` runs besides the quality phases.

commits.description: Lint the commit subjects since the merge base. Off when left out.

oneOf.description: Every subject must be a conventional commit.

FamilyConfig.description:
Changes the curated tools of one family. A capability left out keeps the curated tools.
A list replaces them, unless every entry starts with `+` or `-`: then it adds or removes
those tools, as in `lint = ["+yamllint", "-typos"]`.

LargeFiles.description: Oversized files a change may keep. Lock files are always allowed.

allow.description: Paths, or `dir/` prefixes, that the large-file check skips.

exclude.description: Bazel label patterns that dx leaves out.

description: The optional root file for tier, tool selection and scope.

families.description: Per-family overrides, keyed by family id.

skip_tools.description: Tools dropped from every family, for example `["typos"]`.

tier.description: The tier for every family that does not set its own.

title: dx.toml
